content.short: JPool lets users stake SOL and distributes staked SOL across validators to earn rewards.
content.description: JPool, based in Switzerland, enables users to stake SOL and participate in Solana's consensus to earn rewards. When delegating SOL through JPool, users receive a JSOL token that represents their ownership in the pool and grows as staking rewards accrue. JSOL can be employed as a DeFi instrument for liquidity mining. Delegators may earn staking rewards of about 6.5–8% per year. JPool distributes the SOL staked by delegators across validators to maximize rewards and support decentralization, using a Stake Pool model to broaden stake distribution.
